pages.title: Sprint Endurance
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r II$(br2)§lApplicable to:§r Leggings$(br2)§lEffect:§r While sprinting, negates the extra exhaustion from sprinting: halved at level I, fully negated at level II. Also grants 10% (20% at level II) knockback resistance.$(br2)§lConflicts:§r None$(br2)§lObtained via:§r Enchanting table, loot chests, villager trades
